|game_text=If [[Death Star]] orbits [[Alderaan]] (and [Virtual Block 7] [[Death Star: Central Core (V){{!}}Central Core]] on table), deploy on Death Star and fire [[Superlaser]] at Alderaan; it is 'blown away.' Once during your control phase, if Death Star orbiting a planet (except a Rebel Base) without related sites, may fire Superlaser at planet (regardless of Objective restrictions) as follows: Draw destiny. Add 2 if you control that system. If destiny + Y - Z > 8, target is 'blown away' and opponent loses 4 Force from Life Force. Y = total Death Star sites where opponent has no presence. Z = total sites at Yavin 4.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7)]] (version 3 of 4). The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7)]] (original, release sheet of 18 June 2010); [[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); '''this page''' (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]): Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet, official text as of 18 June 2010<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010, first printing not found), page 4, slip 18 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “If Death Star orbits Alderaan (and [Virtual Block 7] Central Core on table), deploy on Death Star and fire Superlaser at Alderaan; it is 'blown away.' Once during your control phase, if Death Star orbiting a planet (except a Rebel Base) without related sites, may fire Superlaser at planet (regardless of Objective restrictions) as follows: Draw destiny. Add 2 if you control that system. If destiny + Y - Z > 8, target is 'blown away' and opponent loses 4 Force from Life Force. Y = total Death Star sites where opponent has no presence. Z = total sites at Yavin 4.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-00-Commence_Primary_Ignition.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-commenceprimaryignition-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (Dark Side p. 34)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=34 Internet Archive]</ref> reprints it character for character; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]]), and the current text. The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 7 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1271_18">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock7Type (Virtual Block 7 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “If Death Star orbits Alderaan (and [Virtual Block 7] Central Core on table), deploy on Death Star and fire Superlaser at Alderaan; it is 'blown away.' Once during your control phase, if Death Star orbiting a planet (except a Rebel Base) without related sites, may fire Superlaser at planet (regardless of Objective restrictions) as follows: Draw destiny. Add 2 if you control that system. If (destiny + Y - Z) > 8, target is 'blown away' and opponent loses 4 Force from Life Force. Y = total Death Star sites where opponent has no presence. Z = total sites at Yavin 4.” '''What changed:''' Parentheses are added around “destiny + Y - Z” (“If destiny + Y - Z > 8” becomes “If (destiny + Y - Z) > 8”). The same wording is already in the Players Committee's Holotable card data of 1 August 2010<ref name="cdf-1271_18">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/d14e714/db/darkside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 1 August 2010] (Players Committee data, copy on GitHub). Card data is dating evidence only, not a card document.</ref>. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes. The card list itself was generated from that Holotable data (research R7, 11 November 2026): a transcription the Players Committee published, listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-commenceprimaryignition-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]) again, word for word: “If Death Star orbits Alderaan (and [Virtual Block 7] Central Core on table), deploy on Death Star and fire Superlaser at Alderaan; it is 'blown away.' Once during your control phase, if Death Star orbiting a planet (except a Rebel Base) without related sites, may fire Superlaser at planet (regardless of Objective restrictions) as follows: Draw destiny. Add 2 if you control that system. If destiny + Y - Z > 8, target is 'blown away' and opponent loses 4 Force from Life Force. Y = total Death Star sites where opponent has no presence. Z = total sites at Yavin 4.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034727/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “18” at the bottom right, which the release-sheet slip does not.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 34)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]) again, word for word: “If Death Star orbits Alderaan (and [Virtual Block 7] Central Core on table), deploy on Death Star and fire Superlaser at Alderaan; it is 'blown away.' Once during your control phase, if Death Star orbiting a planet (except a Rebel Base) without related sites, may fire Superlaser at planet (regardless of Objective restrictions) as follows: Draw destiny. Add 2 if you control that system. If destiny + Y - Z > 8, target is 'blown away' and opponent loses 4 Force from Life Force. Y = total Death Star sites where opponent has no presence. Z = total sites at Yavin 4.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1271-18-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image do).
